FY  2027 Adopted Budget
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Previously Authorized Projects
Previously Authorized Projects are CIP projects that are being administered by Loudoun
County, were fully funded in fiscal years prior to FY 2027, have a construction phase in the
scope, and are currently in development. This section does not include Information
Technology projects; Landfill projects; General Government Renovation projects; Town
administered projects; individual intersection improvements or sidewalk and trail projects
that originated from the Intersection Improvement Program or the Sidewalk and Trail
Program; VDOT administered projects; and Loudoun County Public School projects.
Additional project status information can be obtained from the Capital Improvement Projects
Quarterly Report, which is provided to the Board of Supervisors’ Finance/Government
Operations and Economic Development Committee on a quarterly basis.

Projects Identified for Future
Development
This section tracks future projects for purposes of managing the growth and priorities of the
CIP. The projects listed are identified for potential inclusion in future CIPs (e.g. outside of the
current six-year plan). Projects appearing on this list are identified from the Capital Needs
Assessment, and the Countywide Transportation Plan, and others are identified during the
annual budget development process. Projects that are triggered by the Capital Needs
Assessment through FY 2040 have been added to the list, except for fire apparatus, transit
buses, parking spaces, recreation trails, and school projects.
This listing of projects allows staff to develop capital budgets strategically and in a more
transparent and data-driven way. A project does not need to first appear in this section to be
considered for prioritization in a future CIP. During subsequent budget processes, prioritizing
these projects will be the basis of capital budget guidance sought from the Board of
Supervisors during the fall.
The table below lists the source of the project’s origination and a high-level cost estimate
(if available), which was developed when the project request originated. These estimates are
not updated during budget development cycles.
